title: UserResponse
description: Full user record returned from create, read, or update operations

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the user

licenseFeatures.description: License features assigned to the user

enabled.description: Whether the user account is currently active

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created this account

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the user was created

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who last updated this account

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update
